description:
Generate sitemap.xml and robots.txt for benchbox.dev. Neither exists today, so these are additive.

Every page gets a canonical URL (on the .html path), a meta description (from frontmatter or meta_description) and Open Graph and Twitter tags.

The 404 page must reproduce the assemble_public_site.py RESULTS_FALLBACK behaviour exactly: an unknown /results/* path stores the target in sessionStorage key benchbox.results.redirect and returns to the Explorer, which restores it. Every other path gets a styled not-found page with search.

Keep CNAME and .nojekyll in the output.
